name: EMBER LANCE
description: A focused bolt of living flame.
effect: Direct hit. A condensed lance of living flame strikes the target and leaves a brief ember trail.

gesture.hint: STROKE 1: LONG DOWNWARD LINE · STROKE 2: UP-RIGHT HOOK

steps.title: Draw the ember stroke
steps.description: Begin at the crown and pull one steady line straight down. Keep the stroke long and centered to anchor the spell.

steps.title: Hook toward the flame
steps.description: Lift or keep holding, then finish with a clean diagonal sweep up and right.

name: LIGHTNING
effect: Direct hit. A storm-charged bolt arcs into the target, branching on impact with a brief electric afterimage and a short stun.

gesture.hint: STROKE 1: DOWN-RIGHT · STROKE 2: DOWN-LEFT · STROKE 3: DOWN-RIGHT

steps.title: Start the discharge
steps.description: Begin high and drive a sharp diagonal down and right. This is the bolt's first fork.

steps.title: Cross the current
steps.description: Lift near the point, then cut down and left to make the lightning zigzag.

steps.title: Finish the strike
steps.description: End with a shorter diagonal down and right. Release cleanly to send the charge forward.

name: AEGIS
description: A reactive shield that catches the next spell.
effect: Raise a luminous ward around the defender. If timed during a projectile flight, it absorbs the next impact completely.

steps.title: Trace the ward
steps.description: Draw one clean square and close the final edge where you began.

name: FREEZE
description: A binding ring of glacial stillness.
effect: Control. Three concentric ice circles lock around the target and freeze it for 2.5 seconds (2500ms); Aegis reduces the freeze to 1 second.

gesture.hint: STROKE 1: OUTER CIRCLE · STROKE 2: MIDDLE CIRCLE · STROKE 3: INNER CIRCLE

steps.title: Trace the outer frost ring
steps.description: Draw one clean, closed circle to establish the edge of the freeze. Keep the ring broad and centered.

steps.title: Echo the middle ring
steps.description: Lift near the first ring, then draw a second closed circle around the same center.

steps.title: Seal the inner circle
steps.description: Finish with the smallest closed circle. Keep all three rings concentric to lock the target in place.
